title: Universal Waypoint script
features:
Hello there welcome to my script, this is my first script on this website so stay tuned for more scripts

This script is fully keyless therefore You dont have to worry about any hidden key systems

Script features: 

-create waypoint

-tp to waypoint

-remove/delete selected waypoint

-clear all waypoints

How to use: 

1. Stand where you want the waypoint to be and enter the name of your waypoint in the name wapoint box(example name; waypoint1)

2. Click on the create waypoiny button

3. Walk afew studs away

4. Click on the tp to waypoiny button to teleport to your selected waypoint
